sloka: सुकेशं राक्षसं जाने ईशानवरदर्पितम् ।तांश्चास्य तनयाञ्जाने येषां ज्येष्ठः स माल्यवान् ।। ७.६.२० ॥
transliteration: sukeśaṁ rākṣasaṁ jāne īśānavaradarpitam ।tāṁścāsya tanayāñjāne yeṣāṁ jyeṣṭhaḥ sa mālyavān ।। 7.6.20 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by the gods, Janardana, the God of gods, who grants fearlessness to his devotees and fear to his enemies, indeed spoke to the gods after granting them protection.
